PreInvocation.command: payload=$(cat); directory=$(printf '%s' "$payload" | jq -r '.workspacePaths[0] // empty'); if test -z "$directory" && command -v homelab-agent-session >/dev/null 2>&1; then directory=$(homelab-agent-session | jq -r '.root // empty'); fi; root=$(git -C "$directory" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if test -f "$root/hooks/antigravity"; then printf '%s' "$payload" | "$root/hooks/antigravity" context; else printf '%s\n' '{}'; fi

hooks.command: payload=$(cat); directory=$(printf '%s' "$payload" | jq -r '.workspacePaths[0] // empty'); if test -z "$directory" && command -v homelab-agent-session >/dev/null 2>&1; then directory=$(homelab-agent-session | jq -r '.root // empty'); fi; root=$(git -C "$directory" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if test -f "$root/hooks/antigravity"; then printf '%s' "$payload" | "$root/hooks/antigravity" failure; else printf '%s\n' '{}'; fi

Stop.command: payload=$(cat); directory=$(printf '%s' "$payload" | jq -r '.workspacePaths[0] // empty'); if test -z "$directory" && command -v homelab-agent-session >/dev/null 2>&1; then directory=$(homelab-agent-session | jq -r '.root // empty'); fi; root=$(git -C "$directory" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if test -f "$root/hooks/antigravity"; then printf '%s' "$payload" | "$root/hooks/antigravity" stop; else printf '%s\n' '{}'; fi
